claim_one_line: THE SLOW LANE'S FIRST FULL RUN, TRIAGED AND DISCHARGED (R52-4; the fifty OA_SLOW-gated files enumerated and launched at B1177 completed after 4h45m: 9 failed, 5702 passed, 5 skipped). The nine in four classes. (A) FIVE REAL DEFECTS, ALL MINE, ALL INVISIBLE TO THE FAST LANE: A1 -- thirteen arc verification scripts carried ABSOLUTE MACHINE PATHS (agent-written scripts copied into frontier/*/verification/ during the close-loop batches without normalizing; the script runs on the bench that wrote it and nowhere else, which is exactly the claim an arc's verification directory makes) -- fixed by deriving the root from each file's own location, all three touched arcs still REPRODUCE; A2 -- TEN ARCS CARRIED A VERDICT AND NO FINDINGS DOCUMENT (B1176-B1179, B1181-B1183, B1194-B1196), the exact mirror of B1176's thirteen retro verdicts and committed by the same seat two days later -- documents authored from each arc's OWN banked record with arc_verdict.json primary, each stamped with that provenance, nothing from memory; A3 -- TWO NEGATIVE ARCS UNROUTED in the kill graph (B1203 symmetry-cannot-select, B1205 dimension-count), the B801 backlog rebuilding within four days of the pass that cleared it -- both routed with kill_form, fact_computed, hatch and priority. (B) TWO LOCKS BUGGED, NOT THE CONTENT: b844's ID strip was greedy-to-a-colon, so a COLON-FREE carried item had its entire reason eaten by the strip and was then flagged for having no reason -- the lock manufacturing the defect it hunts (2 of 127 items; bounded, with the bare-ID control asserted); b1034's L154 allowed-set predated the campaign -- B1190 IS the L154 bridge cell (the successor entitled to the pairing exactly as B1064 is) and the two campaign docs carry its ADJUDICATED row, each stating NO-EXHIBIT / ONE-BRIDGE-MISSING / route-DEAD rather than asserting the join, so all three are admitted CONDITIONALLY under a new test that requires the adjudication language to stay. (C) ONE REAL CODE BUG EIGHT DAYS OLD: B1113's tmeter verifier took TWO dirnames where its depth needs THREE, so REPO_ROOT resolved to frontier/ and every join doubled it (frontier/frontier/B1102_...) -- the verifier has not executed once since it was banked 2026-08-21 and only the slow-gated lock exercises it; fixed, 4/4 pass. (D) TWO CASUALTIES OF THE RUN ITSELF: the atlas render and the suite-cost drift band both PASS IN ISOLATION -- B1203/B1205/B1206 were banked WHILE the 4h45m suite was in flight, so the surfaces moved underneath the assertions measuring them. THE METHOD FACT: a lock run against a moving repository measures the motion -- the slow lane must be run QUIESCENT, or its currency gates report drift as defect (22% of this run's findings were that artifact). THE CLASS, which is the point: three of the five real defects were committed by the seat that had just built or just used the corresponding instrument, so the lesson is not vigilance (vigilance is what failed) but that A GATE ONLY WORKS WHERE IT IS REACHED -- the slow lane becomes a review-cadence quiescent run, which is precisely how it came to sit unrun from its own creation until today. E2 -- B1113's verifier recorded CCB_PATH raw, so the first successful re-run (enabled by this arc's own class-C fix) overwrote the banked hand-sanitized '<repo>/...' placeholders with this bench's absolute paths; now recorded repo-relative with the cert reference elided. E3 -- two further arcs (B1107, B1114) rewrite tracked results with per-run timings only (reverted, not fixed): THE SLOW LANE CANNOT CURRENTLY BE RUN WITHOUT DIRTYING THE WORKING TREE, a second independent reason for quiescence.
